name: Wyckoff Sunday Weekly Analysis
prompt:
Launch the Wyckoff weekly entry funnel in the background — it runs ~6 min, holds a singleton lock (so a retry can't duplicate it), and posts its own Telegram digest (and alerts on failure):

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/wyckoff && nohup .venv/bin/python scripts/entry.py >> logs/entry.log 2>&1 & disown
```

The job is detached and self-reporting; do not wait for it. Respond with [SILENT].

name: Wyckoff Daily Watchlist Scan

```bash
cd ~/.hermes/skills/wyckoff && .venv/bin/python scripts/watchlist_scan.py >> logs/watchlist_scan.log 2>&1
```

If the command exits non-zero, report the last 20 lines of logs/watchlist_scan.log to Roy. Otherwise respond with [SILENT].
